input.summary: Insert an express performance warranty with duration and repair/replace/refund remedy into Section 9
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 contains only mutual corporate authority representations, so HDI gives no warranty on the Site, software or hosting services. We have added the fallback performance warranty: 90 days' conformance to documentation for the Site and software, 30 days for the services, with repair, replacement or refund as our remedy.

ops.text: HDI warrants that (1) for a period of ninety (90) days following the Effective Date, the Site and any software provided by HDI hereunder will conform in all material respects to its documentation, and (2) the services performed by HDI hereunder will conform in all material respects to the requirements of this Agreement for a period of thirty (30) days following performance. For any breach of this warranty, HDI shall, at its option, repair or replace the non-conforming Site, software or services, or refund the fees paid by the Company for the non-conforming Site, software or services.
